name: oc-mc-tools
description: MACO development toolkit for opencell-maco-project (Spring Boot 2.3 / Java 11 / javax.* / Flyway / Spring Data / Spring Batch) — a standalone toolkit, NOT a delta over oc-be-tools, because the Opencell Core backend rules are inverted here (javax vs jakarta, Flyway vs Liquibase, @RestController vs BaseRs, Spring Data vs entity base classes, JUnit 4 + MockMvc vs Arquillian). Ships ten guideline files (critical rules with the core-vs-MACO comparison table, module architecture and dependency direction, entities/sequences/projections, Spring Data repositories, services with the no-@Transactional convention, the /api/rest/v3 CRUD + FiltersDto/ResponseDto search template with @Secured Keycloak roles and Swagger 2, Spring Batch with thread-safe readers and StepExecution counters, Flyway migrations, code quality and testing), seven guideline-loading skills, builder agents for entities+migrations, repositories/services, batch jobs, REST APIs and JUnit 4 tests, a MACO-aware PR reviewer with an explicit scoring rubric, an implementation orchestrator (/oc-mc-implement) whose sub-agents record file manifests and first-pass snapshots, a two-axis review command (/oc-mc-review) folding guideline conformance and JIRA acceptance-criteria conformance into one verdict and tagging the ticket ai_code_review_back, and a thin AI-usage alias (/oc-mc-calculate-ai-use) that supplies the MACO repo profile to the shared cross-team analyzer without forking it.
